function readPartial<K extends string>(key: K, record: Partial<Record<K, number>>): number {
  const value: number = record[key];
  return value;
}

function readOptionalMapped<K extends string>(key: K, record: { [P in K]?: number }): number {
  const value: number = record[key];
  return value;
}

function readRequiredPartial<K extends string>(key: K, record: Required<Partial<Record<K, number>>>): number {
  const value: number = record[key];
  return value;
}

function writeWrongType<K extends string>(key: K, record: Partial<Record<K, number>>): void {
  record[key] = "text";
}

function readPartialField<T, K extends keyof T>(key: K, partial: Partial<T>): T[K] {
  const value: T[K] = partial[key];
  return value;
}

function readonlyPartialAsT<T>(value: Readonly<Partial<T>>): T {
  return value;
}

function tAsReadonlyPartial<T>(value: T): Readonly<Partial<T>> {
  return value;
}
